facetedQuery.summary: Faceted query with filters and a sort replica

example.message: Expected a JSON array of InstantSearch multiple-queries payloads

get.summary: Run a single query via query string, or return a discovery document.
get.description:
Two behaviours are multiplexed onto this endpoint:

### 1. Single-query search (parity with POST)

If any of `q`, `query`, `hitsPerPage`, or `page` is supplied, the gateway constructs exactly **one** multi-query element targeting the `feedback-posts` index and forwards it through the same `@searchkit/api#handleRequest` pipeline as POST. The response is therefore the same Algolia-shaped envelope.

Mapping:

| Query parameter | Maps to            | Default | Coercion                                                            |
| --------------- | ------------------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `q` or `query`  | `params.query`     | `""`    | `q` takes precedence when both are present.                         |
| `hitsPerPage`   | `params.hitsPerPage` | `50`  | Clamped to the inclusive range `[1, 500]`; invalid input falls back to `50`. |
| `page`          | `params.page`      | `0`     | Clamped to `[0, 9999]`; invalid input falls back to `0`.            |

Features that cannot be expressed via query string (multiple queries, facets, filters, custom `indexName`, sort replicas, etc.) require POST.

### 2. Service discovery

With **none** of `q`, `query`, `hitsPerPage`, or `page` present, the gateway returns a small JSON discovery document describing the available endpoints. POST has no equivalent of this mode.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms. Maps to `params.query`. Takes precedence over `query` when both are supplied.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Alias of `q`. Ignored when `q` is also present.

parameters.name: hitsPerPage
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to `50`. Values outside `[1, 500]` or non-numeric input fall back to `50`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index. Defaults to `0`. Values outside `[0, 9999]` or non-numeric input fall back to `0`.

200.description: Either a search-results envelope (when search parameters are supplied) or the discovery document (when none are supplied).

value.description: POST: JSON array of InstantSearch multiple-queries (see /openapi.json). GET: discovery when no search params; otherwise one-query search (q/query, hitsPerPage, page) — subset of POST. Contract: openapi.json.

500.description: Search execution failed upstream. Discovery mode never reaches SearchKit and therefore never produces this status.

options.description: Answered by nginx with `204 No Content` and the public CORS headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, OPTIONS, HEAD`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type, Accept, X-Requested-With`, `Access-Control-Max-Age: 86400`). The gateway process is not involved.

get.description: Proxied by nginx to the gateway's internal `/health` endpoint. Returns `200 OK` with the plain-text body `ok` when the gateway process is reachable. A `502 Bad Gateway` indicates that nginx cannot reach the gateway upstream.

502.description: nginx cannot reach the gateway upstream.

get.description: Served as a static file by nginx. Always reflects the contract of the gateway running on the same host.

MultiQueryRequest.description: InstantSearch multi-query payload. Each element describes one query against one index. Field semantics follow the Algolia search API; see SearchKit and Algolia documentation for the full set of `params` keys.

indexName.description: Target index. The primary index is `feedback-posts`. Sort replicas exposed by the gateway are `feedback-posts_created_desc` and `feedback-posts_score_desc`.

params.description: Algolia-compatible search parameters. Only the most common fields are listed here; any field accepted by `@searchkit/api` may be supplied.

query.description: Free-text query. Empty string matches everything.

facets.description: Facet attributes to compute. Post-level attributes: `board_slug`, `board_name`, `status`, `category_name`, `author_name`, `vote_highEngagement`, `vote_lowEngagement`, `vote_moderateEngagement`, `score`, `maxScore`, `commentCount`, `mergeCount`, `trendingScore`. Nested comment-level attributes (match posts with at least one comment satisfying the filter): `comment_author_name`, `comment_aiGenerated`, `comment_pinned`, `comment_internal`, `comment_private`, `comment_integrationSourceType`, `comment_itemSourceType`, `comment_likeCount`.

facetFilters.description: Algolia-style facet filter expression (string, array of strings, or array of arrays for OR-of-AND).

SearchResponse.description: Algolia-compatible search-results envelope produced by `@searchkit/api`. The `results` array contains one entry per query in the request, in order.

SearchResult.description: Single-query result. Mirrors the Algolia `SearchResponse` shape; only the most commonly consumed fields are documented here.

page.description: Zero-based page index of this result.

hitsPerPage.description: Page size used for this result.

query.description: Echo of the query string that was executed.

facets.description: Facet counts keyed by facet attribute, then by facet value.

Hit.description: Indexed feedback post document. Includes the full `_source` plus standard Algolia hit metadata (`objectID`, `_highlightResult`, `_snippetResult`). Only the fields the gateway is configured to return are listed below; consult `index_mappings.json` for the canonical field set.

DiscoveryResponse.description: Returned by `GET /api/search` when no search parameters are supplied.
